sections.subheading: Transform the Way Your Physiotherapy Practice Operates
sections.paragraph: At VirtualAssistant.com.au, our AI Virtual Receptionist is designed specifically for physiotherapists and allied health professionals. It answers calls instantly, manages appointments, provides service information, and ensures your patients always receive prompt, professional communication — even after hours.

sections.subheading: Stay Focused on Patients, Not Paperwork
sections.paragraph: Our AI Receptionist takes care of repetitive admin so you can stay focused on hands-on treatment. It can book, reschedule, and cancel appointments, send reminders, and answer common patient questions — all through natural conversation. You’ll never need to worry about missed calls or double bookings again.

sections.subheading: Never Miss a Call or Booking Again
sections.paragraph: Whether you’re with a patient or your reception desk is busy, the AI steps in instantly to handle incoming calls and online messages. It provides details about services, pricing, and availability, then confirms appointments in real time. Your clients get the attention they deserve, even when you’re unavailable.
